scope: first-party package.json (excludes vendor, third_party, .agents, skills, packages/agent-browser-skills, crates/*/docs and www sites)

dependencies.name: @modelcontextprotocol/sdk
dependencies.status: removed from web-mcp and web-cli (now @yolo-web/mcp-native); kept in brave-search-mcp and as a test-only devDependency of mcp-native (reference client for the handshake tests)
dependencies.why: brave-search-mcp registers ~10 tools through McpServer.registerTool with zod shapes, output schemas and a JSON-Schema dialect shim; replacing it means rewriting every tool schema, an upstream-derived package

dependencies.name: commander
dependencies.why: only subcommands, options, variadics, negation and defaults are used

dependencies.name: zod
dependencies.status: removed from web-mcp (unused); kept in brave-search-mcp
dependencies.why: MCP SDK registerTool requires zod shapes; stays with the SDK

dependencies.name: ai
dependencies.status: removed; Vertex generateContent over fetch with an ADC bearer token (4 tests)

dependencies.name: google-auth-library
dependencies.why: Application Default Credentials resolution (service account JWT, authorized_user refresh, GCE metadata, external accounts), OAuth2 refresh and PKCE exchange; a crypto.subtle JWT would cover only the service-account case and would change behavior

dependencies.name: @googleapis/drive
dependencies.why: files.list/get/create/export plus resumable behavior at ~20 call sites and drive_v3 types shared by tests; a fetch client is feasible but is a separate rewrite

dependencies.name: @googleapis/docs
dependencies.why: documents.get/batchUpdate with docs_v1 types in drive-reconcile-review and docs-wordcraft

dependencies.name: lighthouse
dependencies.status: removed from devDependencies; script uses bunx lighthouse@13.6.0

dependencies.name: typescript
dependencies.why: bun check resolves TypeScript 7 native packages from it

notChecked: apps/* and packages/chrome-extension-yolo declare no external dependencies beyond workspace links; crates/brave-star/star-wasm/www and crates/brave-bot/docs/website are upstream sites left alone
